models.name: fct_otif_parcel_fulfillment
models.description: End-to-end supply chain OTIF parcel fulfillment mart tracking 16.5M+ parcels and warehouse robotics SLAs.

columns.name: parcel_fulfillment_sk
columns.description: Deterministic SHA-256 surrogate key for parcel_id and fulfillment_hub_id.

columns.name: dispatched_date
columns.description: Partition date when the parcel was dispatched from the fulfillment hub.

columns.name: otif_status
columns.description: On-Time In-Full classification (OTIF_MET, LATE_DELIVERY, SHORT_SHIPPED, OTIF_FAILED_BOTH).

models.name: fct_subscription_mrr_retention
models.description: Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) and subscriber cohort retention mart across 894K+ active subscriptions.

columns.name: subscription_month_sk
columns.description: Surrogate key combining subscriber_id and activity_month.

columns.name: current_mrr_gbp
columns.description: Net monthly recurring revenue billed in GBP for the subscriber in the activity month.

columns.name: mrr_movement_type
columns.description: MRR bridge classification (NEW, EXPANSION, CONTRACTION, CHURNED, REACTIVATED, RETAINED).

models.name: dim_fulfillment_hub
models.description: Conformed warehouse fulfillment hub dimension with robotics automation tier attributes.

columns.name: fulfillment_hub_sk
columns.description: Primary surrogate key for the fulfillment hub dimension.

columns.name: fulfillment_hub_id
columns.description: Natural business identifier for the international logistics hub.
